scope: Chinese-language primary-source audit of Wuhan, Chongqing, Suzhou and Hangzhou
method: Official Chinese sources plus direct read-only portal requests; metadata only, no polygon collections, ownership attributes, credentials or private login. Earlier failures retained in their original files. Documented existence and public query are distinct from verified anonymous viewport geometry.

cities.name: Wuhan
cities.assessment: Actual cadastral holdings and visual parcel query are explicitly documented; no anonymous viewport/native-ID polygon response was obtained.

sources.title: 以多领域应用激发产权数据活力——武汉市产权底板建设的探索与实践
sources.finding: Official bureau publication describes an integrated cadastral/property basemap including 120,000 state construction-land parcels, parcel-based survey holdings and a native property-unit-code association. Standardized cross-department services are described; these are not evidence of anonymous APIs.
sources.evidenceMethod: official Chinese HTML, reviewed via web reader

sources.evidenceMethod: official Chinese search-indexed article; open currently returned FAQ listing

cities.assessment: 苏易登 online cadastral queries and the Gusu section are documented. Zhangjiagang, a county-level city administered by Suzhou, provides a real-name visual/query/print flow; this does not establish citywide anonymous coverage.

publicCatalogueInspection.assessment: All four keyword searches returned HTTP/application 200. 地籍 has 0 title matches; 宗地 has 4, 不动产 has 6, 土地 has 25. Only 3 catalogue titles sampled per keyword; industrial-parcel and supply-plan catalogue matches remain candidate records whose geometry/identity/delivery schemas have not been inspected. A bounded keyword search is not proof of absent datasets.

cities.name: Hangzhou
cities.assessment: Current official annual report documents cadastral survey/registration data operations and 3D cadastral pilot work. Its full-coverage unified cadastral-database statement appears under future plans, so this audit does not claim that milestone was completed or that an anonymous polygon API exists.

sources.evidenceMethod: official Chinese HTML, direct HTTP 200 and web reader
